details:
Recently i came across a 12 year old using malicious mods, notorious and other mods, he crashed over 5 sets of people trying to join a public world, he also ripped one of my personal models thats on private.
Its gotten to a point where if children who shouldnt even be able to play this game have the ability to not only play but modify aspects of the game.
What i propose is an injector detection system or I.D.S, this software will scan the files of the game and ensure nothing has been modified and that there are no injectors such as melon loader active, this program would detect the mods or injector and stop the game from starting.
Im very aware that people are going to say "people will work around it" and "not gonna work" but this softwares goal would be to reduce the amount of access the average player has to modified clients.
To those who are pro mod who will give this post shit, do this for the kids who are not only ruining this game for others but also ruining their own experience. 
You want vrc to be better? Make it so that kids cant make it bad.
title: Anti-cheat/injector detection system
